title: Canonical coefficient coherence for a nested open square
statement: For g':X'→X, W≤U opens and N∈D(X), the canonical derived-pullback comparison maps for the nested open square satisfy the coefficient coherence identity obtained by specializing coefficient_square_coordinate_change to W.ι, U.ι, the two pullback projections, X.homOfLE i and relativeMVOpenLift g' i, with coefficient morphism the identity of (derivedPullback g').obj N.

proof.text: Apply coefficient_square_coordinate_change with v=W.ι, z=U.ι, t=qW, s=pW, qz=qU, pz=pU, e=X.homOfLE i, b=relativeMVOpenLift g' i, K=N, K'=(derivedPullback g').obj N and phi=identity. The open inclusion, pullback lift and pullback condition identities provide the five square equalities. Expand the comparison isomorphism components and simplify functorial identities; proof irrelevance identifies equality transports.

lean.statement: theorem canonical_relativeMV_open_square_coefficient_coherence [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (W U : X.Opens) (i : W ≤ U) (N : schemeDerivedCategory X) : (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι)).map ((relativeMVComp (X.homOfLE i) U.ι ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ derivedPullback k) (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X i))).hom.app N) ≫ (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) W.ι).hom.app N ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj N) (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫ (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' W.ι) g').inv.app N = (relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' W.ι) (X.homOfLE i) ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ derivedPullback k) (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).symm) ≪≫ (relativeMVComp (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).symm).hom.app ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj N) ≫ (derivedPullback (relativeMVOpenLift g' i)).map ((relativeMVComp (pullback.snd g' U.ι) U.ι).hom.app N ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj N) (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := U.ι)).symm) ≫ (relativeMVComp (pullback.fst g' U.ι) g').inv.app N) ≫ (relativeMVComp (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ derivedPullback k) (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _))).hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj N)
